title: Data-Driven Care Planning for Multimorbidity
official: Optimizing Primary Care Delivery: Data-Driven Care Planning to Improve Veteran Health Outcomes
summary: The objective of this study is to compare the effectiveness of VET-PATHS (VETeran PAnel Management Tool for High-Risk Subgroups), a novel data-driven panel management tool, to a standard high-risk patient list tool for helping VA primary care teams manage Veterans at highest risk for hospitalization and poor health outcomes.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Research participants are VA clinical staff on general primary care teams (includes women's health primary care teams) with:

* Team-assigned PCP \>/= 0.5 Full-Time-Equivalent (FTE)
* Team panel patients (active, total) \>/= 600
* Core staff positions filled at time of enrollment (Clinical associate, RN care manager)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Team focuses solely on a specialized type of primary care patient. For example, teams that focus on patients with housing instability, HIV, or spinal cord disorders
* Home-Based Primary Care teams are also excluded
sponsor: VA Office of Research and Development

sites.f: VA Pittsburgh Healthcare System University Drive Division, Pittsburgh, PA
